witness.description: Exact recomputation of F(N), the maximum size of a Sidon subset of {1,...,N} under the both-sums convention (all pairs i<=j), for N=1..24; asserts F(N+1) <= F(N)+1 for every N in [1,23], equality (sharpness) at N=1 and N=3, and agreement of both Sidon conventions (all-sums and off-diagonal-only) on this range.

claim: verify(witness) returning True without raising certifies the finite fragment of L1: F(N+1) <= F(N)+1 holds for all 1 <= N <= 23 under both Sidon conventions (all-sums and off-diagonal-only), with equality at N=1 and N=3 (sharpness instances); covers=fragment — the universal 'for all N>=1' quantifier and the non-liftability to k>=2 are not decided by this finite check.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
